title: India Targets 100 GWe Nuclear Capacity by 2047 & 5 Operational Indigenous SMRs by 2033
summary: India set target to expand nuclear power capacity to 100 GWe by 2047 and operationalize 5 Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) by 2033.

blocks.content: India set target to expand nuclear power capacity to 100 GWe by 2047 and operationalize 5 Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) by 2033.

items: **Nuclear Capacity Target:** Increase India's nuclear power capacity to **100 GWe by 2047**.
**SMR Target:** Operationalize at least **5 indigenous Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) by 2033**.
**Three-Stage Program:** Stage I (PHWRs natural uranium), Stage II (Fast Breeder Reactors plutonium), Stage III (Thorium utilization).
